title: Verify the European tilemap stream bank
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Join all 78 retained tilemap streams into one contiguous physical bank and account for all 302 aligned reference words.
validation: Wine 58n8155h checks the original source hashes, upper boundary, reference projection and E301 ownership. The manifest owns 844 of 9,864 bank bytes. Protected inputs passed and Wine drained.
limitations: Mode 3 is absent in the verified bank. Other sources, live callers, integration, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No payload export or performance measurement.
